title: Arrival
speaker: Bram
text: The water has pulled back. The marked stones lead through the reef.

title: The safe crossing
speaker: Tamsin
text: These tide marks explain when the route is safe. We can repair the crossing.

title: A working route
speaker: Neri
text: The same wave seal. This ledger records deliveries to the inner station.

title: Behind the Vault
speaker: Ivo
text: The passage leads back beneath the Vault. Someone kept this route marked.
